spec.hypothesis: Method sensitivity patterns (Granger FDR collapse, cross-correlation dominance) generalize from GPT-2-small to GPT-2-medium, validating cross-architecture universality of methodological pitfalls

reproduce.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && mkdir -p results/gen_wiki_gpt2m_a100_s42 && HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python -u iterative_train.py --model_name gpt2-medium --data_dir data/wikitext103_5k --synthetic_ratio 1.0 --num_generations 10 --steps_per_gen 5000 --batch_size 32 --seed 42 --output_dir results/gen_wiki_gpt2m_a100_s42"

metrics.cross_arch_note: vs Pythia-410m: same qualitative pattern (entropy leads diversity), more extreme calibration collapse but milder diversity loss. 14/16 xcorr pairs peak at lag=0. Granger selective: canary→diversity sig (p<0.003), canary→ppl not sig.
